summaries.demographer: Edgard Franco is a 33-year-old white non-Hispanic man born and living in Evansville, Indiana, with German and Irish Midwestern ancestry (Q85-Q89). He is married, lives with his wife, has no children, and rents his home in the 47715 area (Q05, Q51, Q58). He has a STEM bachelor's degree and is currently not in the workforce after leaving data analyst work to pursue UX research and interactive media (Q16, Q65, Q90). His household is financially modest but not in acute crisis, relying mainly on his wife’s income while managing savings, student debt, and some credit card balance (Q61-Q64, Q74, Q83).
summaries.behavioral_economist: Edgard shows high curiosity and creative intrinsic motivation but weaker deadline discipline and present-biased project behavior, repeatedly describing unfinished portfolio work and late-night tinkering (Q03, Q18, Q44). He accepts short-term financial risk to pursue better identity fit in work, but his household responds to uncertainty with budgeting, reduced discretionary spending, and savings use (Q60-Q62, Q81). He is loss-aware around health insurance, emergency bills, and fragile savings, especially after leaving stable employment (Q36, Q82, Q83). Peer and spouse influence matter: his wife’s spreadsheet discipline and practical questions shape his financial and career choices (Q05, Q55, Q81).
summaries.political_scientist: Edgard is a center-left, Democratic-leaning Independent who votes in presidential and usually midterm elections but is less consistent in local primaries (Q23, Q95, Q96). His politics emphasize health care, civil rights, climate, education, affordability, arts funding, trails, and practical local institutions rather than strong partisan identity (Q24, Q25). He is sympathetic to Black Lives Matter concerns, sees racism as systemic, and has responded through listening, small donations, one local event, and private conversations rather than sustained activism (Q26-Q30). His institutional trust is selective: he values evidence-based sources and local practical infrastructure while distrusting performative politics and online conflict (Q24, Q42, Q48).
summaries.psychologist: Edgard presents as introverted, curious, technically analytical, and aesthetically motivated, with a self-concept built around bridging data, craft, and visual storytelling (Q01, Q65, Q109). He is prone to anxiety, avoidance, and inconsistent routines, especially under ambiguous self-directed work conditions (Q43-Q45). His coping strategies include hiking, trail running, cooking, quiet guitar, tinkering, and talking with his wife, though he also recognizes procrastination and late-night work as maladaptive patterns (Q38, Q44, Q50). Relationally, he is loyal but solitary, relying most on his wife and a small circle of activity-based friends (Q05-Q07, Q109).
